newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 4.799 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 4.799 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Monday cotton output in the 1996/97 (July-June) crop year had reached a provisional 4.799 million 375 lb bales by November 21, up from 4.258 million bales in the same period last year.
The Corporation said mills had purchased 3.301 million bales, up from 2.680 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had bought 1,100 bales against 307,400 last year.
A total of 1.496 million unsold bales were stocked at ginning factories, compared to 1.271 million bales in the same period a year ago, it said.

Officials estimate cotton production will exceed nine million bales in the whole of 1996/97. The crop has suffered pest damage during the past few months, mainly in Punjab province, the major cotton producer.
The estimate is down from earlier forecasts of 10 million bales and last year's production of 9.96 million.
